basic_info.description: Offered for sale is 436 Marietta Drive, on the market for the first time since being purchased by its original owners in 1958. This 4 bedroom/2 bath, plus family room home boasts an expansive 2,232 square feet of living space, on a 2,774 square foot lot. The entry leads to a large living room with an abundance of natural light, brick fireplace, views, plus a spacious dining room.  The kitchen was expanded to create an eating area and family room with direct access to a new deck.  Also on this level are two nice size bedrooms, and a full bath.  The top level is dedicated to the primary suite, which has beautiful bay and hill views, a full bath, and ample closet space.  In the past, the seller removed two decks on this level that faced the rear and front of the property. There is a possibility of rebuilding those decks to take further advantage of the delightful views and outdoor space.  There is a large bedroom on the street level with a separate entrance, which could also serve as a home office, or room for a nanny or extended family member. A very large, 2 car, side-by-side garage completes the home. Minutes from transportation, shopping, Glen Park BART, Noe Valley, West Portal, Eureka Valley.
